name: Residence Permit for Spouse / Family Reunification

requirements.blocker_text: Available to the spouse or registered cohabiting partner of a person legally resident in Iceland. Gender-neutral.
Sponsor must have secure means of support; this is checked at renewal and affects rights in special circumstances (divorce, death of sponsor, domestic abuse).

evidence_required.document: Proof of sponsor's secure means of support

outcome.duration_length: generally 1 year at a time, up to a maximum of 2 years; cannot exceed the sponsor's own permit validity

sources.title: Island.is -- Residence Permit for Spouse: Residence Rights: 1-2 year permit duration, secure means of support, protections after divorce/death/abuse (short marriage may disqualify continuation)

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Iceland). pr_after_months (36) and citizenship_after_months (48) reflect the reduced 3-year permanent-residence and 4-year naturalisation thresholds specifically available to spouses of Icelandic citizens (see is_permanent_residence.json and is_citizenship_by_marriage.json) -- these reduced figures apply only when the sponsor is an Icelandic CITIZEN, not merely a resident; a family-reunification applicant whose sponsor is a foreign resident (not yet a citizen) would instead face the general is_permanent_residence.json/is_naturalisation.json timelines (4 years / 7 years). Modeled the citizen-sponsor case as the outcome shown since is_citizenship_by_marriage.json is listed as a switchable_to target; flagged as an assumption, not a universal guarantee for every sponsor type.
